title: Organization
bodyText: . The development of occupational employment planning information shall be carried out through the responsibilities defined in section 373C-23.
bodyHtml: §373C-42  Organization.  The development of occupational employment planning information shall be carried out through the responsibilities defined in section 373C-23. [L 1983, c 193, pt of §1; am L 2001, c 171, §7]
